project_type: TypeScript monorepo - multi-source music aggregator with NestJS backend, Next.js frontend, Python AI services
build_system: pnpm workspaces (9.15.0), tsc for individual packages, no Turbo/Nx
test_framework: vitest for apps/api unit tests, unplugin-swc for decorator support
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, 2. pnpm run lint, 3. pnpm run typecheck, 4. pnpm run build, 5. pnpm run test
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via 'prisma generate' (part of build script)
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install, 2. Copy .env.example to .env, 3. pnpm infra:up (docker compose), 4. pnpm run dev
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22. Docker available. pnpm available globally. No running DB available in sandbox (schema-only validation via prisma format/validate).
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits, ESLint + Prettier enforced, strict TypeScript
key_patterns: Prisma schema at apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma. Existing models: User (with passwordHash, role enum listener/enthusiast/power_user/admin), PrivacySetting, AuditLog. PrismaModule is global. RLS middleware exists at apps/api/src/common/middleware/rls.middleware.ts. Extensions in docker/postgres/initdb/01-extensions.sql.
directory_structure: apps/api (NestJS backend), apps/web (Next.js frontend), services/ai (Python FastAPI), packages/shared (TS contracts), packages/connectors/{yandex-music,youtube-music,file-import} (connector implementations), docker/ (initdb scripts)
